text_block_list.text:
The day after watching the race with<n>
Tazuna...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hello again, Trainer! Welcome to the<n>
Japan Umamusume Training Center<n>
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This is the finest Umamusume training<n>
establishment in Japan, home to<n>countless
students who dream of the<n>racing world!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Director Akikawa! You scared<n>
us!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Apologies! Seeing such a promising new<n>
trainer just gets me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Introductions! I am Akikawa, the director<n>
of this academy! I look forward to your<n>
endeavors, newcomer!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: But first... Please! Tell us about yourself!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!<n>
Trainer<n><username>,<n>
from here on, you are a part of
Tracen<n>Academy!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
High hopes! I expect you'll give your all<n>
together with your trainees to make their<n>
dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The goal of our academy's students is to<n>
participate in the highly renowned<n>
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
So I want you, Trainer, to teach, guide,<n>
and support your trainees through and<n>
through!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That's all! I hope that you will work<n>
diligently to bring honor to the trainer<n>
badge you wear on your chest!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's set off for the<n>introduction
course,<n>
Trainer <username>!
